value.rationale: The exact attraction basin is a natural, complete invariant of the specific published numerical benchmark, whose primary application is precisely attraction-domain certification. It quantifies a substantial gap (area factor \(81\sqrt3\pi/128\), approximately 3.443) between the actual basin and its certified square while showing that square to be radius-optimal within its shape. The additional exact finite-time area shells and quantitative geometric thin-shell escape law describe the uncertainty-sensitive transient near a sharp stability boundary; they are not a merely arbitrary invariant or finite computation. Elementary reducibility limits breadth but does not eliminate the value of a complete and independently useful benchmark.
